method.method_draft: First describe the regression output in the image: it shows a fitted equation, then a coefficient table with columns Predictor, Coef, St Dev, T, and P. Locate the row for the predictor Hours, because the hypothesis H0: beta = 0 tests whether the slope for hours worked is zero. Read the entry in the T column of that Hours row; it is -1.61. Report -1.61 as the t-test statistic.
